source_text: The polymer already has confinement. System now makes the wall explicit: outside the chosen radius, a harmonic force pushes particles inward. Increasing wall stiffness reduces penetration; zero switches the force off. This is a soft wall, so particles are not clipped back to the boundary. The diagnostics report excursions for mechanical particles and released RNA. For a small locus, this sphere is a modeled domain, not automatically an entire nucleus. Compare radius and wall strength, because packing can change contacts and transcription even when every biochemical parameter stays the same.
